title: Carson Phase 4 — as-built pallet position count

disregarded: Quote Q-38857-1 (916 bays / 7,196 net) — a priced commercial document, not a statement of what was installed
Quote Q-38857-8 (551 bays / 4,268 net) — a different scope at a different point in the job's life
source.why_this_artifact: It is the only one of the three whose own breakdown reconciles: 6,980 gross − 156 lost = 6,824 net, exactly.

not_established.beam_levels_per_bay: NOT RECORDED. 6,980 / 916 = 7.6201, so no uniform level count reproduces the gross figure — the job is a mixed configuration and the drawing does not break it down by run. A fixture asserting a per-bay level count would be inventing one.
not_established.loss_breakdown_by_reason: NOT RECORDED. The drawing gives the 156 total; it does not say which positions were lost or why. The engine's per-reason breakdown therefore cannot be checked against this artifact.
not_established.positions_per_bay: NOT RECORDED, and not derivable without the level count.

anchor_ratio.note: 3,812 / 953 = 4.000 exactly. Independent of the position count, and the basis for the BOM's anchor rule.
